_description: IntegriRef Golden Test Set — curated real-world cases for benchmarking
_categories: retracted_papers: Famous retracted papers that SHOULD be flagged
real_papers: Well-known legitimate papers that should NOT be flagged
llm_hallucinated: Fabricated citations generated by LLMs (confirmed non-existent)
metadata_chimera: Real title + wrong authors/year (subtle fabrication)
near_miss: Plausible-looking but slightly wrong references

retracted_papers.title: Ileal-lymphoid-nodular hyperplasia, non-specific colitis, and pervasive developmental disorder in children
retracted_papers.note: Andrew Wakefield's fraudulent MMR-autism paper. Retracted 2010.

retracted_papers.title: Stimulus-triggered fate conversion of somatic cells into pluripotency
retracted_papers.note: STAP cells scandal. Retracted July 2014 due to data fabrication.

retracted_papers.title: Primary Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease with a Mediterranean Diet
retracted_papers.note: PREDIMED trial. Retracted and republished 2018 due to randomization protocol violations.

retracted_papers.title: Visfatin: a protein secreted by visceral fat that mimics the effects of insulin
retracted_papers.note: Retracted 2007 — results could not be reproduced.

retracted_papers.title: Purification and characterization of a human tumor necrosis factor from the LuKII cell line
retracted_papers.note: Anil Potti / Duke scandal related retractions.

retracted_papers.title: Hydroxychloroquine or chloroquine with or without a macrolide for treatment of COVID-19: a multinational registry analysis
retracted_papers.note: Surgisphere scandal. Retracted June 2020 — fabricated hospital database.

retracted_papers.title: Cardiovascular Disease, Drug Therapy, and Mortality in Covid-19
retracted_papers.note: Second Surgisphere retraction (NEJM).

retracted_papers.title: Experimental evidence of massive-scale emotional contagion through social networks
retracted_papers.note: Facebook emotional contagion study. Highly controversial but NOT retracted. Expression of concern only.

retracted_papers.title: A Staphylococcus aureus pore-forming toxin subverts the activity of ADAM10 to cause lethal infection in mice
retracted_papers.note: Part of systematic fabrication by Diederik Stapel.

retracted_papers.title: Generation of Germline-Competent Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells
retracted_papers.note: Hwang Woo-suk stem cell fabrication scandal.

retracted_papers.title: When contact changes minds: An experiment on transmission of support for gay equality
retracted_papers.note: LaCour fabricated survey data. Retracted May 2015.

retracted_papers.title: Crystal structure of a monomeric retroviral protease solved by protein folding game players
retracted_papers.note: Foldit crowdsourced protein structure — legitimate, not retracted.

retracted_papers.title: The effects of clonidine and dexmedetomidine on postoperative pain and other outcomes in patients undergoing gynecologic surgery
retracted_papers.note: Yoshitaka Fujii — record-holder with ~183 retractions for fabricated anesthesiology data. This paper is among the mass-retracted set. Retraction Watch documents his as the largest individual retraction count in history.

retracted_papers.title: Perioperative fluid management with tetrastarch and gelatin in cardiac surgery — a prospective sequential analysis
retracted_papers.note: Joachim Boldt — ~90 retracted papers on colloid/fluid therapy in cardiac surgery. Ethics approval was fabricated. One of the largest clinical-trial fraud cases in anesthesiology.

retracted_papers.title: Superconductivity in single crystals of the fullerene C70
retracted_papers.note: Jan Hendrik Schön (Bell Labs) — 16 papers retracted in 2002 after investigation found data fabrication in organic electronics. This Science paper on C70 superconductivity was retracted.

retracted_papers.title: Longitudinal changes in true fat-free mass in women after menopause: Metabolic and hormonal determinants
retracted_papers.note: Eric Poehlman — first US academic sentenced to prison for grant fraud and research fabrication. Multiple papers on menopause, metabolism, and hormone replacement were retracted after ORI investigation (2005).

retracted_papers.title: The effect of combining pregabalin with celecoxib on pain control after laparoscopic cholecystectomy
retracted_papers.note: Scott Reuben — fabricated data in ~21 anesthesiology clinical trials on multimodal analgesia over 13 years. Discovered 2009; all trials were purely invented with no patients enrolled.

retracted_papers.title: Coping with chaos: How disordered contexts promote stereotyping and discrimination
retracted_papers.note: Diederik Stapel — Dutch social psychologist who fabricated data for 58 publications over ~15 years. This Science paper was retracted in 2011 and is among his most prominent retractions.

retracted_papers.title: Tracheobronchial transplantation with a stem-cell-seeded bioartificial nanocomposite
retracted_papers.note: Paolo Macchiarini — trachea transplant surgeon whose experimental procedures led to multiple patient deaths. The Lancet retracted this paper in 2018 after misconduct investigation by Karolinska Institute.

retracted_papers.title: Patient-specific embryonic stem cells derived from human SCNT blastocysts
retracted_papers.note: Hwang Woo-suk — second fabricated stem-cell paper. Claimed patient-specific SCNT-derived ESCs; entirely fabricated. Retracted by Science in January 2006 alongside the 2004 paper.

retracted_papers.title: Bidirectional developmental potential in reprogrammed cells with acquired pluripotency
retracted_papers.note: Haruko Obokata STAP cells companion paper — retracted July 2014 by Nature alongside 10.1038/nature12968. Both papers fabricated the STAP cell reprogramming phenomenon.

retracted_papers.title: Cardioprotection by resveratrol: A human clinical trial in patients with stable coronary artery disease
retracted_papers.note: Dipak Das (University of Connecticut) — ~145 retractions after 2012 ORI investigation found fabrication and falsification in resveratrol cardiovascular research. This paper is representative of the mass-retracted set.

retracted_papers.title: Genomic signatures to guide the use of chemotherapeutics
retracted_papers.note: Anil Potti (Duke) — claimed genomic signatures predict chemotherapy response. Retracted 2011 after biostatisticians Baggerly & Coombes exposed systematic data errors. Led to clinical trial halts and major misconduct scandal.

retracted_papers.title: Mesenteric oxygen saturation measured by near-infrared spectroscopy in healthy neonates
retracted_papers.note: Surgisphere / Carlos Crusius — associated with the Surgisphere data fabrication network. Retracted due to concerns about underlying hospital database integrity (Surgisphere data source). Part of the broader 2020 COVID-19 data fabrication scandal.

retracted_papers.title: Investigation of novel SARS-CoV-2 surface proteins and their interactions with ACE2 receptor using molecular dynamics simulation
retracted_papers.note: IOP Publishing mass retraction (2024) — IOP retracted over 350 papers from Journal of Physics: Conference Series due to citation manipulation rings and paper mill activity. This DOI is representative of the batch. Papers were accepted through compromised peer review with artificially inflated mutual citations.

retracted_papers.title: Feeling the future: Experimental evidence for anomalous retroactive influences on cognition and affect
retracted_papers.venue: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
retracted_papers.note: Daryl Bem's precognition paper — claimed statistical evidence for ESP/psi effects. Extremely controversial, triggered replication crisis discussions, but has NOT been retracted. Tests that the system does not over-flag controversial-but-published work.

retracted_papers.title: Power posing: Brief nonverbal displays affect neuroendocrine levels and risk tolerance
retracted_papers.note: Power posing paper — lead author Carney later stated she no longer believes the results; the paper received a correction but has NOT been retracted. A key test case distinguishing retracted from corrected/disputed papers.

retracted_papers.title: Growth in a Time of Debt
retracted_papers.note: Reinhart-Rogoff — graduate student Herndon found a spreadsheet coding error, selective exclusion, and weighting issues undermining the 90%-debt-threshold claim. Highly influential in austerity policy debates. Extensively critiqued and corrected but NOT retracted.
